findings.title: [P2] Preserve the existing empty-name behavior
findings.body: When `profile.name` is `""` or contains only whitespace, `trim()` produces `""`. The previous `??` expression returned that empty string, while the new `||` expression returns `"Anonymous"`. This changes an existing API result for valid input despite the PR’s stated contract-preservation goal. Use a nullish check if empty names must remain distinct from missing names.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of applying the fallback
findings.body:
For `{ name: "" }` or whitespace-only names, the previous API returned `""`; `name || "Anonymous"` now returns `"Anonymous"`, breaking the stated existing contract and any rendering/tests that distinguish an explicitly blank name from a missing name.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
